title: Ya Fatima Zehra Ya Fatima Zehra
body:
Ya Fatima Zehra Ya Fatima Zehra
<<MINI>>
Hum Apke Bachou Ke Azadar Hai Bibi
<<DIVIDER>>
1.Dekho Toh Meri Qaum Ke Bachou Me Bhi Hai Gham
Jo Maaou Ki Gudhi Me Kiya Karte Hai Matam
Nadan Bhi Ho Kar Yeh Samjhdar Hai Bibi
<<MINI>>
Hum Apke Bachou Ke Azadar Hai Bibi
<<DIVIDER>>
2.Aashoor Ka Din Hai Ke Qayamat Hai Manzar Aur Gardan-e-Shabbir Pa Chalta Raha Kanjar
Har Simt Se Ab Naiza-o-Talwar Hai Bibi
<<MINI>>
Hum Apke Bachou Ke Azadar Hai Bibi
<<DIVIDER>>
3.Din Dhal Gaya Aur Asr Ka Hangham Jo Aaya
Sab Qatl Howe Rehgaye Tanha Shahe Wala
Bhai Na Bhatije Hai Na Ansar Hai Bibi
<<MINI>>
Hum Apke Bachou Ke Azadar Hai Bibi
<<DIVIDER>>
4.Khoon Roti Howi Aahigayi Shaam-e-Ghariba
Bimar Bhatija Hai Toh Zainab Hai Pareshan
Ab Koun Yateemou Ke Madargar Hai Bibi
<<MINI>>
Hum Apke Bachou Ke Azadar Hai Bibi
<<DIVIDER>>
5.Kausar Ki Dua Hai Liye Abbas Ka Parcham
Hum Sab Dar-e-Shabbir Par Jakar Karey Matam
Bus Itni Inayath Ke Talabgar Hai Bibi
<<MINI>>
Hum Apke Bachou Ke Azadar Hai Bibi
